name: MIPLIB
description: MIPLIB (Mixed Integer Programming Library) is the standard benchmark library for mixed-integer linear programming solvers, providing a diverse collection of real-world and synthetic MIP instances from academia and industry. MIPLIB 2017, the most recent edition, contains 1065 instances (240 benchmark, 825 collection) spanning logistics, scheduling, network design, and combinatorics. Solvers are evaluated on feasibility detection, primal solution quality, and optimality proof within time limits.
typical_sota_score: Top solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX) close >85% of benchmark instances to optimality within 1-hour time limits.
reputation: The de facto standard benchmark for MIP solvers; used by all major commercial and open-source solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, HiGHS, SCIP). Maintained by a community of operations research researchers.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; designed for mathematical optimization solvers. Some instances are computationally intractable within practical time limits. New submissions accepted via community portal. MIPLIB editions: 1992, 1996, 2003, 2010, 2017.
